topology.routing: Only the peer overlay host route through the namespace-local TUN; underlay peer stays on veth. No host route, default-route, NAT or forwarding change.
topology.security: Identical mutual-TLS CA/peer pins for matched Raw/Zstd runs. Test private keys stay outside uploaded evidence. Separate peer state between arms.

correctness.application: Receiver checks exact bytes and length against the deterministic fixture, not only a producer-reported digest. Record sender and receiver hashes and byte counts.
correctness.udp: Bounded sequence accounting, duplicate/loss/reorder reporting and any application retries; retries are counted and never hidden. Final exact fixture reconstruction required.
correctness.packet_codec: Separate same-input IP-packet encode/decode roundtrip witness proves exact header, payload, length and checksum preservation. Live TCP segmentation/header differences are not asserted identical across arms.
correctness.opaque_scope: Seeded opaque bytes are a noncompressible control, not proof of intercepting or decrypting Internet TLS.
correctness.warm_scope: No warm-packet arm exists in the first gateway. Shared warm-object core and MVM facade are verified separately.

measurement.packet_capture: One underlay veth interface, both directions, before QUIC handshake through clean shutdown. Header-only classic PCAP with original record lengths retained; bounded capture file.
byte_counts: captured Ethernet frame bytes without FCS/preamble/interframe gap
measurement.wire_includes: QUIC handshake/authentication, acknowledgments, framing and observed retransmissions in both directions; packet capture is not substituted by encoded payload length.
measurement.capture_acceptance: Capture ready before traffic, kernel drops zero, complete bounded parse, final packet count matches capture count; preserve any incomplete capture as failure, not a savings claim.
measurement.cpu: Sender/receiver gateway process CPU and application process CPU separately; no nested process double count and no physical-energy claim.
measurement.time: Per-flow source start through receiver exactness acknowledgment, plus complete peer-session wall time including handshake/preparation/shutdown; ordinary send-only timing is not end-to-end time.
measurement.statistics: Three descriptive paired trials; medians and trial-paired ratios; report negative outcomes and raw fallback costs. No p95 or statistical qualification.

custody.cleanup: Terminate/reap only owned processes and delete only owned namespaces, generated private test material and temporary fixtures after public evidence custody; retain formal logs.

source_binding: Explicit GitHub pull_request.head.sha checkout, recorded together with GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA and source/binary manifests before traffic

dose.warmup_policy: Fresh authenticated peer session for each mode/IP/trial; retain all three cold-start session trials. Prepared codec state persists across the four flows. No JIT trial discarded.
dose.network_impairment: None in the initial functional/measurement witness; no WAN claim. A later shaped run requires a separate explicit profile.
dose.application_reliability: UDP stop-and-wait exact echo; at most ten attempts per chunk, retransmissions and receipt traffic counted; no claim of native UDP reliability

scope: Isolated local Linux TUN/QUIC witness; not WAN, production fleet networking, FIPS or CUI qualification
